coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (38%, rounded): consistent use of R² as an evaluation metric, an 80% development/20% test split, and the 26 car-design parameters. Training sizes and model architectures overlap only partially.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed CSV path. Training fractions omit 60% and 80% and introduce other levels. AutoGluon and a distinct GradientBoosting model are missing, while unrelated architectures are added. Morphological stratification and subgroup analysis do not establish the required Fastback-only versus combined-dataset comparison. Uses RMSE as the primary outcome and 10 replicas instead of average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected improvement with increasing training size and the model-specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
